application_credentials.description:
Home Assistant cannot invite anyone to a calendar event, so this integration talks to Google directly - and Google needs the credential to be yours. One-off setup:
1. Enable the [Google Calendar API]({api_library_url}).
1. On the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) choose **External**, then **publish** the app. Left in testing it hands out a refresh token that expires after seven days, and the link would need renegotiating every week. Published but unverified is fine - it is your own app, used by you.
1. At [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) create an **OAuth client ID** of type **Web application**, with `{redirect_url}` as an authorised redirect URI.
1. Paste the client ID and secret below.
